summaries.en: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu hailed a temporary ceasefire with Lebanon, brokered by President Trump, as a "historic opportunity" for a peace deal, but refused to withdraw Israeli forces from southern Lebanon during the truce.
summaries.zh: 以色列总理内塔尼亚胡将美国总统特朗普斡旋下与黎巴嫩达成的临时停火视为签署和平协议的“历史性机遇”，但拒绝在停火期间从黎巴嫩南部撤军。
